rows.text: *puff* Finally, a chance to catch my breath. I've been standing dead still for ages in this competition of endurance against those other statues...
rows.speaker: Sculpted Nymph

rows.text: I didn't know they'd all start moving as soon as you walked into the room... What an easy win.
rows.speaker: Sculpted Nymph

rows.text: Sounds like one-third of that win belongs to me.
Crrk! When you put it like that, you're not exactly wrong...
rows.speaker: Sculpted Nymph

rows.text: But you can't move at all.
Crrk crrk — How could you say such a thing! We're jiggling around happily when you aren't looking!
rows.speaker: Sculpted Nymph

rows.text: Anyway, I won this contest all thanks to you!
rows.speaker: Sculpted Nymph
